info.longName: Infrastructure Capital Small Cap Income ETF

funds_data.description: The fund, under normal conditions, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of small-capitalization companies. It defines small-capitalization companies as those companies with a market capitalization, at the time of initial investment, that is within or below the range of companies in the Russell 2000® Index.
